summary: Canaan Inc., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, attaching unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2026 as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is an ordinary periodic financial disclosure, not a special situation. It shows total assets of US$446.2 million at June 30, 2026, down from US$602.9 million at year-end 2025, with cash of US$66.0 million, accumulated deficit widening to US$847.1 million, and total shareholders' equity of US$292.7 million. The report is incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-3 shelf. No deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or transactional mechanics are stated. Watch for routine interim-report disclosure only, with no risk-arb angle.
